blocks.text: You can manually remediate the alerts generated for a policy. The Remediation tab provides detailed steps that you need to perform in your cloud service provider (CSP) to address the policy violation. After the violation is addressed in the CSP, all the corresponding alerts generated for that policy are resolved.
When you remediate an alert, the policy violation is resolved in the CSP and the Zscaler Admin Console. The alert moves from the Open state to the Resolved state.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Alerts.
On the individual alert's page, select the Remediation tab to view the details.
You can also access the Remediation tab from the Grouped by Policy tab, Grouped by Resource tab, Dashboard, and the Resource Inventory page.
